stock.description: As an investment holding company, Ruifeng Power Group Company Limited primarily focuses on the conceptualization, fabrication, and distribution of cylinder blocks and cylinder heads throughout the People's Republic of China. The enterprise additionally furnishes vital structural components for these blocks, such as bearing caps and flywheels. Its clientele is diverse, encompassing producers of passenger, commercial, and industrial vehicles, alongside manufacturers of engines. The firm was established in 2002, with its corporate headquarters situated in Shenzhou, PRC. Ruifeng Power Group Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Dragon Rise Ventures Limited.
